method: Actual inspection of 11 saved final-hash screenshots through the image viewer, independently of the script assertions. No complete video playback was newly watched in this batch.

observations.seen: Main race controls, remaining distance, rider labels, energy and attack controls are present and separated from the scene. No newly missing rider bodies, wrong-colour cache tiles or clipped primary buttons were visible. The compact metrics continue below the viewport through normal page scrolling.
observations.limitation: At 320, small speed units and auxiliary button text are tightly packed; this remains a P3 readability limitation rather than a new cache regression.

observations.seen: The wider scene and two-column data layout remain intact. Script-measured full-quality canvas is 1902×538 CSS pixels; no blank central canvas or geometry break is visible.
observations.limitation: Secondary text remains small at the captured 4K scale. A resized overview does not establish comfortable native-panel reading distance or replace physical-device inspection.

observations.seen: Close control, tabs, search, group summary and position rows are readable and aligned in the captured 390-wide view.
observations.limitation: This screenshot does not test touch precision or every long rider/team name.

observations.seen: Foreground riders and bicycles remain complete; mountain silhouettes, roadside objects, road slope and focus labels show no obvious aliasing corruption from reusing cache canvases. The descent frame shows a low tucked body consistent with coasting. Dense groups preserve the existing overlapping pack aesthetic.
observations.limitation: These are single captured frames of automated real-RAF playback; they cannot alone prove smooth cadence, scene continuity between every frame or a particular FPS. Exact cached-raster parity is verified separately.

observations.scope: Sprint approach / finish line / winner ceremony
observations.seen: The finish line, remaining-distance emphasis, foreground rider body and winner platform remain intact in three captures. Winner flowers and feet do not visibly separate from their supporting pose/platform in the inspected ceremony frame.
observations.limitation: Two approach frames and one award frame do not replace watching the full ceremony. Full 1× playback evidence remains attached to the prior SHA558f source, with exact source-isolation proof for the new hash.
